offences.quote: Using an AI tool (e.g., ChatGPT) to generate your assignment or test answers and submitting them as your own, unless the assignment specifically requires the use of such a tool
Using an AI tool (e.g., ChatGPT) to rewrite your assignment or test answers and submitting them as your own, unless explicitly permitted in the assignment instructions

detection.quote: From 2025, the University of Waikato will be using Turnitin functionality to identify work that have been a result of GenAI use.
